data.gender_notes: Ruthia is used as a unisex name in Christian naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Ruthia is a Hebrew name meaning "Friend of God". In the Bible, the Book of Ruth tells the story of Ruth, a Moabitess who converted to Judaism and became the great-grandmother of King David. Ruth demonstrated faithfulness, courage, and loyalty to her mother-in-law Naomi and to her God. The name Ruthia carries the meaning “Friend of God” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Hebrew, Greek. Parents who choose Ruthia usually hope their child will grow to embody friend of god and live with faith, good character and purpose.

data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Ruthia total 5, giving a life-path number of 5. Number 5 is linked with Mercury and with the qualities of freedom, adaptability and curiosity.

data.cultural_impact: The name Ruthia pays homage to the biblical character Ruth, who is a significant figure in Jewish and Christian history. Her story epitomizes the power of loyalty, courage, and faith in the face of adversity. Her conversion from Moabitess to Judaism serves as an inspiration for those seeking to move towards a new faith or belief system. The name is also a reminder of the importance of interfaith relationships and the ability for people of diverse backgrounds to connect and form bonds.
data.spiritual_significance: Ruthia is a powerful name that symbolizes the spiritual journey of embracing God as a friend and guide. It reflects the belief that friendship with God is a source of comfort, strength, and unwavering support. The name Ruthia is a reminder that even in the face of adversity and change, maintaining connections to our spiritual beliefs can provide a strong foundation for personal growth and fulfillment.
